# Feature description
**[EDIT THIS]** 
Add horizontal scrolling to very wide Markdown tables.

## Why is this feature needed?
**[EDIT THIS]**
Right now, if Gemini generates a table with 20 columns, it tries to squish the text to fit the screen. It would be better if the table stayed wide and we could just scroll it left and right.

## Proposed solution (optional)
**[EDIT THIS]**
Add `overflow-x: auto;` to the `.markdown-table-wrapper` CSS class.

## Alternatives considered (optional)
**[EDIT THIS]**
Zooming out my browser window, but that makes the text too small to read comfortably.
